display_long_description:
Step inside an Olympic stadium and compete in the two most prestigious precision shooting disciplines  **10m Air Pistol and 10m Air Rifle.**

Whether you're a first-time shooter or a competitive athlete, SportyXR is built around authentic Olympic sport mechanics. No spray and pray. Every shot scored to Olympic standard.

# TRAIN YOUR WAY
Range Practice gives you open-ended solo sessions to build consistency and technique at your own pace.

# COMPETE AGAINST AI
Arena Match puts you against 9 AI opponents across four difficulty tiers - Easy, Mid, Hard, and Expert. Watch the live leaderboard update in real time after every shot.

# PLAY AGAINST REAL PEOPLE
Multiplayer lets you create or join a room with up to 5 players. Same Olympic stadium, same live leaderboard - but now you're up against real humans.

Track your best streak, chase your personal record, and hear the crowd react when you nail a high score.

**Precision. Presence. Performance.**
